title: Mayor Lurie Signs Legislation Increasing Relocation Payments for Displaced Renters
abstract: Raises Required Ellis Act Payments by 25%, Nearly $3,000 per Tenant, to Reflect Rising Cost of Finding a New Home in San Francisco; Part of Mayor Lurie's Rent Emergency Package, Builds on Work Under Administration’s Family Opportunity Agenda
body:
SAN FRANCISCO – Mayor Daniel Lurie today signed legislation increasing the payments landlords must make to tenants displaced under the Ellis Act by 25%, nearly $3,000 per person, to better reflect the cost of finding a new apartment in San Francisco. The legislation, which Mayor Lurie sponsored, is part of the rent emergency package he announced in September to protect against unwarranted evictions and prevent sudden rent spikes.
